senses.definition: n.pr.loc. on border of Ephr.:—only c. ה loc., נַעֲרָ֫תָה Jos 16:7 (𝔊 αἱ κῶμαι αὐτῶν; 𝔊L id. + Αναραθα); appar. = נַעֲרָן, q.v. infr.; Νοοραθ lay 5 Rom. miles from Jericho LagOnom. 283, 11 cf. BuhlGeogr. 181.
